title: BouquetSpec v1
description: SRS Appendix B. Records what the customer chose, never how it is drawn or what it costs (D-07). Business rules that a schema cannot express (unique ids, stem limits per size, stock, incompatible flowers, item types) are checked by the server (NFR-SEC-07, FR-DSG-14). cardMessage length is counted in Unicode code points.

occasion.description: One of the occasions defined by the admin.

size.description: Stem count (sum of flowers[].qty) must stay inside the admin limits for this size (FR-DSG-04).

flowers.description: Main and secondary flowers. At least one.

cardMessage.description: Up to 200 characters. Never sent to the AI provider (FR-DAI-02) and excluded from the spec hash.

previewMode.description: Display only; never affects the price. Excluded from the spec hash.
